d: Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a small ahoge on top. Golden yellow eyes with a playful, smiling expression on a youthful, adolescent face. A slender, petite build wearing a dark navy blue oversized hooded dress with vertical pinstripes, featuring purple ribbon bows on the sleeves and a high collar. Two small red horns sprout from the forehead, and a long, thick, segmented purple and grey demonic tail with sharp dorsal spines curves upward from behind.
